title.zh: DeepSeek新模型叠加AI融资担忧，亚洲芯片股连续下跌
title.en: DeepSeek新模型叠加AI融资担忧，亚洲芯片股连续下跌

current_state.zh: Asian chip stocks extended losses as DeepSeek's new, more resource-efficient model update combined with doubts over US AI infrastructure financing (CoreWeave, Anthropic/Nscale listings) to fuel fears of weakening semiconductor and memory demand, dragging the Kospi to its worst weekly decline since October 2008.
